metadata.notes: Confirmed transport commands have been verified by replay on hardware. REC and STOP were verified previously; PLAY BA 57 03 is now also verified over the USB ALSA Mixer Control Port.

commands.name: PLAY
commands.description: Playback command. Verified on hardware over the USB ALSA Mixer Control Port with MIDI bytes BA 57 03.
